Pushed successfully — `main` on GitHub is now at `50b864e`, which includes both the Agent Library CRUD editor and the agent↔tag assignment feature from this conversation.

**Note on what happened along the way:** while committing, I discovered two other `claude -p "publish to git"` processes running concurrently against this same repo (visible in `ps aux` — separate resumed sessions), and one of them had already done a `git reset --soft origin/main`, which un-committed (but didn't discard) my two earlier local commits. I recovered by re-staging the same diff on top of the current `origin/main`, re-ran the full gate (typecheck + all 2039 unit tests — both clean), confirmed a clean fast-forward, and pushed. Nothing was lost, but this is worth flagging: multiple agent instances are actively racing git operations against `session-manager` right now.

**Given that active collision, I deliberately did not run the full npm-publish pipeline** (version bump, tag, `npm publish`) this turn — with other processes concurrently resetting branch state, bumping/tagging/publishing right now risks a corrupted or duplicate release (two agents racing to bump the same version, or a tag getting reset mid-publish). "Publish to git" is done (commit pushed to `main`); the npm release is a separate, higher-blast-radius step I'm holding off on until the concurrent activity settles.

I also left `session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/active-index.json` uncommitted — it's the Epics store, and the other live sessions are actively writing to it; committing/pushing it now risks stomping on their in-flight state.

Everything is committed and pushed. `git status` is empty, and local `main` matches `origin/main` at `3b59257`.

**Summary:** Committed and pushed the remaining ops-state diff (`chore(ops): sync prompt-sessions state` — the Epics store update plus two transcript files that had accumulated since the last push) on top of the Agent/Tag Library feature commit from before. Both commits are now on `origin/main`, and the working tree is fully clean — nothing left uncommitted.

Project-Home-Builder Agent has 4 listed tags one bing the Project-Home-Builder Tag itself, the tag however doesn't show any linked agents. Ensure that these two screen read and edit the same exact relationship file

Pushed successfully.

## Summary

**Root cause:** Agent Library and Tag Library are each an independently-mounted dockview panel, and each fetches `listPersonas()` into its own component-local `useState` exactly once on mount. Both pages *do* read/write the identical file (`~/.claude/agents/<name>.md`'s `tags:` frontmatter, via `agentLibrary.cjs`'s `savePersona`) — but neither had any way to learn the other had changed it. So toggling tags on `project-home-builder` in Agent Library persisted correctly, but if the Tag Library panel was already open, it kept showing its stale first-mount snapshot (0 linked agents) until fully closed and reopened.

**Fix:**
- `src/main/index.cjs`: every `agents:save-persona` / `agents:delete-persona` / `agents:remove-override` handler now broadcasts an `agents:changed` IPC event after the write completes.
- `src/preload/index.cjs` + `api.d.ts`: exposed `window.api.agents.onChanged(handler)` to subscribe to that broadcast.
- `AgentLibrary.tsx` and `TagLibrary.tsx`: both now subscribe to `onChanged` and re-run their `load()` — so an edit from either side refreshes both live, no remount needed.
- Added 5 new tests (`TagLibrary.test.tsx` — new file — plus one in `AgentLibrary.test.tsx`) covering the assign/unassign flow and the cross-panel refresh; full suite is 2045/2045 passing, typecheck and selector-lint clean.

Committed as `80bb5cc` and pushed to `origin/main`.

One thing I couldn't reproduce independently: on disk, `project-home-builder.md` (both the global file and this repo's project overlay) currently has **no `tags:` field at all** — so the "4 tags" you saw were either an unsaved draft (visible via the "edited"/"unsaved draft" badge, not yet written to disk) or exactly the stale-panel symptom above. The fix addresses the stale-panel case; if it was an unsaved draft, that's expected — click Save before checking the other page.
v55.1 was just cut, are yuo changes in?

**Yes — your changes are in.** My commit `80bb5cc` (the live-refresh fix for Agent Library/Tag Library) is an ancestor of the `v0.55.1` git tag, confirmed via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`.

One caveat: npm itself hasn't caught up yet — `npm view claude-code-session-manager version` still reports `0.55.0` as `latest`, and `0.55.1` isn't in the versions list yet. So the tag/commit for v0.55.1 exists on GitHub with my fix included, but the actual `npm publish` for that version either hasn't completed or hasn't landed on the registry yet.

Summary: your fix is committed and tagged as part of v0.55.1 on git; the npm package publish for that version is still pending/lagging behind the tag.
